Underground raw water pump was running in loop to fulfil the raw requirements at user points. In order to fulfil the raw water requirement raw water overhead tank is installed. The underground raw water pump is running only while filling the overhead raw water tank.
Usage of Cooling tower water for chilling requirement in process as well as HVAC

Water system UF rejection to Cooling tower

Reduction of water qty being used in Linezolid stage-1
Water qty is reduced by 5 times of batch size in Linezolid stage-1
COD load reduction of HTDS effluent

Recovery of Linezolid product stage-2 mother liquor containing IPA+Methanol+water is started for separation and sale of IPA+Methanol+water mixture to reduce the COD load of effluent being transferred to ETP.
